newsHighlights.title: A look at China's economic data in October
newsHighlights.summary: China's economy remained stable in October, with new growth drivers strengthening and the economic structure improving under enhanced policy coordination.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国10月经济数据发布：在政策协调加强的支撑下，中国经济10月保持稳定，新动能持续增强，经济结构不断优化。

newsHighlights.title: Nation's opening-up fuels growth across Asia-Pacific
newsHighlights.summary: China's continued opening-up is widely seen as a powerful engine fueling sustainable growth across the Asia-Pacific region.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国持续扩大开放被视为推动亚太地区可持续增长的强大引擎。

newsHighlights.title: US lawmakers question Trump's involvement in Nvidia CEO's return
newsHighlights.summary: US lawmakers have raised questions over the president's reported involvement in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to the country's market.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国国会议员就总统据报道介入英伟达CEO黄仁勋重返美国市场一事提出质疑。

newsHighlights.title: Weekly train service linking China, Mongolia and Russia launched
newsHighlights.summary: A weekly international rail service connecting China, Mongolia and Russia has been launched, strengthening regional trade links.
newsHighlights.translation: 连接中国、蒙古国和俄罗斯的每周国际班列正式开行，进一步强化区域贸易联系。

newsHighlights.title: CAR-T expertise draws foreign cancer patients
newsHighlights.summary: China's medical expertise in CAR-T cell therapy is attracting a growing number of foreign cancer patients seeking treatment.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国在CAR-T细胞疗法方面的医疗专长正吸引越来越多前来求医的外国癌症患者。

quote.quote: Price is what you pay; value is what you get.
quote.author: Warren Buffett
quote.translation: 价格是你付出的，价值是你得到的。
quote.explanation: 投资大师巴菲特提醒我们：不要只盯着价格的高低，而要关注资产本身的价值。做商业决策时，短期的成本不应掩盖长期的回报，这一理念也呼应了今日新闻中'以开放换取长期增长'的逻辑。

pattern.pattern: 主语 + remained + 形容词，with + 名词 + 现在分词（with复合结构作伴随状语）
pattern.example: China's economy remained stable in October, with new growth drivers strengthening and the economic structure improving.
pattern.translation: 中国经济在10月保持稳定，新增长动能不断增强，经济结构持续优化。
pattern.usage: 该句型用 with + 名词 + V-ing 表示'伴随着……（同时发生）'，常见于经济与商业报道。使用时注意：with 后的名词是动作的发出者，故用现在分词（表主动/进行）；若为被动关系则用过去分词，如 with the policy implemented。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语与状语（Past Participle as Modifier & Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 新闻标题和正文中大量使用'过去分词短语'来精简句子：放在名词后作定语，相当于省略了 which/that was；放在句首或句末作状语，表示被动或已完成的动作。这种结构能让商业新闻语言更紧凑、专业。
examples: A weekly train service linking China, Mongolia and Russia launched, strengthening regional trade links.
The growth, underpinned by enhanced policy coordination, beat market expectations.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第四个音节 -na- 上：co-or-di-NA-tion。前面的 co- 弱读为 /kə/，中间的 di 也弱读为 /dɪ/，最后的 -tion 读 /ʃn/ 且元音弱化为 /ə/。注意不要把重音错放在第一个音节。
examples: Better policy coordination is essential for stable growth.
The launch required close coordination between three countries.

reading.title: China's Steady Economy and Opening-Up Power Asia-Pacific Growth
reading.content: China's economy remained stable in October, with new growth drivers strengthening and the economic structure improving, underpinned by enhanced policy coordination. Analysts say the data point to resilient domestic demand and a healthy business environment. Meanwhile, the nation's continued opening-up is fueling growth across the Asia-Pacific region. The launch of a weekly train service linking China, Mongolia and Russia has strengthened regional trade links, while foreign patients are drawn by Chinese medical expertise in CAR-T therapy. At the same time, US lawmakers questioned political involvement in a business decision concerning Nvidia's CEO, reminding investors that policy risks still matter. For companies operating in Asia, the message is clear: stable markets, sustainable growth and open trade remain the foundations of long-term value.
reading.translation: 中国经济在10月保持稳定，新动能持续增强，经济结构不断优化，这得益于政策协调的加强。分析人士认为，这些数据表明内需具有韧性，营商环境健康。与此同时，中国持续扩大开放正推动整个亚太地区的增长。连接中国、蒙古国和俄罗斯的每周列车服务开行，强化了区域贸易联系；外国患者也被中国在CAR-T疗法方面的医疗专长所吸引。与此同时，美国国会议员就涉及英伟达CEO的一项商业决策中的政治介入提出质疑，提醒投资者政策风险依然重要。对于在亚洲经营的企业而言，信息很明确：稳定的市场、可持续的增长和开放的贸易仍是长期价值的基础。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily《A look at China's economic data in October》《Nation's opening-up fuels growth across Asia-Pacific》《Weekly train service linking China, Mongolia and Russia launched》《CAR-T expertise draws foreign cancer patients》及 CGTN《US lawmakers question Trump's involvement in Nvidia CEO's return》改写，用于英语学习，非原文转载。
